properties.displayName: UAV S47 - MAVROS Command Injection (Mission Planner Bypass)
properties.description: MAVROS 명령 주입 탐지 — 정상 임무 플래너 경로(Approved_ROS_Node_List의 Role=mission_planner)를 우회해 setpoint 토픽(/mavros/setpoint_raw/local, /mavros/setpoint_velocity/cmd_vel, /mavros/setpoint_position/local)에 직접 명령을 publish하는 비인가 노드를 탐지. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0831 Manipulation of Control
properties.query:
let plannerNodes = _GetWatchlist('Approved_ROS_Node_List') | where Role == "mission_planner" | project NodeName;
let setpointTopics = dynamic(["/mavros/setpoint_raw/local", "/mavros/setpoint_velocity/cmd_vel", "/mavros/setpoint_position/local"]);
let alertWindow = 10m;
UAVRos_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == "topic_publish"
| where TopicName in (setpointTopics)
| where NodeName !in (plannerNodes)
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("MAVROS_설정점명령_임무플래너_우회_", NodeName)
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, NodeName, PeerIp, TopicName, CommandSummary, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S47 - MAVROS Command Injection (Mission Planner Bypass) - {{UAVId}}
